RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, meaning sex is virtually certain not to have been a factor in the hiring decision. An all-female panel selecting one woman over another provides no legal or factual basis for a claim of sex discrimination. 

Raising the panel's gender composition would likely be viewed as baseless and could damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting the written feedback you were promised. Keep the focus entirely on objective hiring criteria—such as qualifications, administrative leadership experience, and interview performance—to understand how the decision was reached and to gain constructive insight for future applications.
